info.name: Synaplan Integration
info.summary: Summaries, translations, chat and AI search for your files, powered by Synaplan
info.description:
Bring Synaplan's AI into Nextcloud Files:
- **Summarize** a document with one click - **Translate** a file into another language - **Chat about this file**: ask questions about one document - **Make searchable by AI**: the AI finds the file when you ask a question, in the chat or in Synaplan - **AI chat** with a knowledge folder and model of your choice, optional personal memories, and live status (model, language, images and videos) - **Answer language**: a default language, or each person's Nextcloud language - **Connect your Synaplan account**: people sign in once, and the AI actions run as them - **Five languages**: English, German (informal and formal), Spanish, French and Turkish
Requires a running Synaplan instance. Three ways to connect: one shared account, accounts created by the administrator, or each person connects their own Synaplan account.
info.author: Synaplan
